senses.gloss: śeṣapati, a certain royal officer: Mvy 〔3739〕 = Tib. gñer ba (misprinted gṅer ba), administrator.

śeṣita, prob. read śekhita, ppp. to śekhayati, instructed: na mayā kumāro kahiṃci śilpe śeṣito atipremnena Mv 〔ii.73.10〕, I have not instructed the prince in any^1 art from too great affection; also id. 15.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20210831. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/80.
